request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-16T16:00:00+02:00:
Bij de storm van woensdag is een groot stuk van het pannendak van de boerderij weggewaaid. Je kunt zo de lucht in kijken. Het regent binnen op zolder.

Repair estimate lines:
- ROOF-TILE-REPL: Oud-Hollandse pannen vervangen (age on estimate: 48.0)
- ROOF-STRUCT-REPAIR: Panlatten vernieuwen (age on estimate: not stated)
- SCAFFOLD: Steiger 1 week (age on estimate: not stated)

what_happened.value: During the storm a large part of the tiled roof of the farmhouse blew away
what_happened.quote: is een groot stuk van het pannendak van de boerderij weggewaaid

location.value: Roof and attic of the farmhouse

affected_items.label: Tiled roof
affected_items.quote: een groot stuk van het pannendak van de boerderij weggewaaid

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date resolved from 'woensdag' relative to Friday 2026-10-16, giving Wednesday 2026-10-14. No time, emergency measures or item ages stated by the customer. Whether the opening has been covered is not mentioned, so source_stopped is null.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports that a large part of the farmhouse's tiled roof blew off in Wednesday's storm and rain is now coming into the attic.
